messages:
julia: Opening thread for BrightShop ticket 8921. They report a spike of 429s on /v1/rerank yesterday during a bulk index job. Also some responses had flat scores (~0.0) for many candidates and p95 latency spiked. Attaching their support logs.

sam: Can you paste the sample request and the error body they received? Also any request ids we can look up?

julia: Pasted (redacted) sample: 
```http
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "mens trail running shoes",
  "candidates": ["cand_1", "cand_2", "cand_3", "... approx 1200 items ..."],
  "top_k": 20
}
```
Error body they saw: 
```json
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","detail":"per_customer_rerank_items_per_minute","retry_after":30}
```
Request IDs: r-9f8e7d6c, r-9f8e7d6d.

vlad: Quick note: our metering counts total candidate evaluations per minute per customer (not just request QPS). 1200 candidates * multiple requests will eat the items/min budget fast.

rachel: From runtime logs for r-9f8e7d6c I see a downstream shard timeouts; we dropped a sub-batch and defaulted to score 0.0 for those entries. That explains the flat scores. Also the client retried with no backoff which caused repeated 429s.

julia: Customer says their pipeline is: ANN returns 1k candidates, then they call rerank. They expected rerank to handle that volume. They asked if the quota can be increased and whether rerank should accept large lists.

sam: For support response: explain current quota model (items/min), recommend pre-filtering to 200-500 candidates or paginate, implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After, and propose Dedicated for sustained high throughput. Also offer a temporary quota increase while they migrate. I'll draft reply.

ops-bot: alert: customer=brightshop exceeded per_customer_rerank_items_per_minute at 2026-03-10T18:12:00Z; items=9860; threshold=2500.

vlad: Action items for engineering: 1) Make partial failures explicit in API (return array of per-candidate status or partial_failure field) instead of silent 0.0 fallback. 2) Improve documentation with recommended upper bound and pagination examples. 3) Add per-customer items/min metric to Console.

prodeng: Filed infra ticket INF-4940 to investigate transient shard timeouts and to enable a one-off quota bump for brightshop for 48h while they refactor. Filed runtime bug RUNTIME-1304 for explicit partial failures. Filed docs task DOCS-205 to add rerank best practices. Filed support ticket SUP-3324 for customer comms.

julia: Sent customer a scoped reply: included sample pagination pseudocode, exponential backoff snippet, recommended chunk size (<=350), and offer for temporary bump. They accepted the bump and will start paginating.

vlad: Also recommended they consider two-stage rerank: cheap model or lexical features to cut candidates to ~150 then high-quality reranker for final sort.

sam: For immediate support: suggested they log request ids whenever they see 429s and send them to us. Also asked them to avoid aggressive immediate retries (use jittered backoff).

prodeng: INF-4940 notes: quota bump applied at 2026-03-11T09:00Z for 48h. Observed traffic pattern was bursty during nightly index job; after paginating and backoff, items/min dropped to below threshold. We'll propose a Console change to surface "items/min used" for customers.

julia: Customer reported improved behavior after applying pagination; they still saw a handful of 429s during restart but reduced by 90%. They've accepted plan to implement a two-stage filter and to evaluate Dedicated for future sustained load.

vlad: One more internal follow-up: add a clearer 429 detail code for rerank quota with human-friendly text and link to docs. Patch ticket PROD-UX-110.

sam: ETA roundup: INF-4940 (quota bump + infra review) 3 hours for immediate work, deeper infra follow-up T+3 days. RUNTIME-1304 (partial failure API) 3 business days for patch + rollout. DOCS-205 3-2 days to publish guidance. PROD-UX-110 (429 UX text) 3-5 days.

ops-bot: resolved alert linked to INF-4940.

julia: Closing thread for customer after confirmation and follow-ups filed. Tagging: @vlad @prodeng @sam for tracking.
